test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

He advised his friend to lose some weight.

options.text: He told to his friend, “Please lose some weight.”
He told his friend, “You should lose some weight.”
He told his friend, “I may lose some weight.”
He told to his friend, “You must lose some weight.”

solution:
The correct answer is: **He told his friend, “You should lose some weight.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is an indirect speech and we need to convert it into a direct speech.
 
• The given sentence is also an imperative sentence.
 
• We follow these rules in Direct-Indirect speech for an imperative sentence:
 
 
• The sense of command, order, advise, request and suggest is implied in the reported clause of the sentence. We have to change the reporting verb in accordance with the mood of the sentence. 
 
• In the imperative sentence the reporting verb ‘said’, ‘said to’, ‘told’ changes to advised, command, requested, ordered, etc. depending on the mood of the sentence. 
 
• Imperative sentence changes to statement form [direct to indirect speech]
 
• We use **'to'** to connect the two clauses in the indirect speech part. when advising something to someone.
 
• In the indirect speech if we use 'advised', 'suggested' etc then it denotes a proposal.
 
 
 
• Example -* **Dad said to my brother, “Work hard to succeed.” (Direct)*

* Dad advised my brother to work hard to succeed. (Indirect)*

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

The Direct sentence is: *He told his friend, “You should lose some weight.”*
